The transaction was flagged under the 'card_not_present_new_device' pattern, as it originated from a device marked as 'New' for the account. Investigation confirms a fraud probability of 0.82, supported by the customer's history of four prior closed fraud cases, including a confirmed card-not-present fraud case from September 2016.
